scientific_integrity: The proof uses Kummer carries and exact four-state matrix identities. Independent mathematical validation and priority determination have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for binary valuations and complete dyadic index intervals only; no odd-prime or arbitrary-endpoint assertion. Broad block-digit matrix methods are antecedents, and unlocated equivalent specializations remain a priority risk.
title: Exact dyadic joint valuation law for two binomial factors
